advisory-brief-planner.short_description: Turn a natural advisory request into a reviewable contract
advisory-brief-planner.default_prompt: Use $advisory-brief-planner to preserve this assignment's facts, define its contract, and prepare the Clara workflow handoff.
advisory-brief-planner.instructions: Describe the advisory assignment naturally and provide any current source materials. Clara preserves the material facts, dates, numbers, entities, constraints, and explicit questions; defines the decision, deliverable, scope, evidence plan, assumptions, analytical approach, success criteria, validation, and professional judgement boundary; then prepares the reviewable advisory_contract.json handoff to the appropriate Clara workflow.

clara.short_description: Turn evidence into reviewable advisory work
clara.default_prompt: Use $clara to organize these materials, identify gaps, and prepare a reviewable analysis or deliverable.
clara.instructions: Provide the case materials and describe the decision or deliverable you need. Clara organizes the evidence, selects the appropriate specialist workflow, and returns a reviewable analysis, report, or presentation with sources, assumptions, and unresolved questions kept visible.

advisory-deliverable-validator.short_description: Check advisory work against evidence and scope
advisory-deliverable-validator.default_prompt: Use $advisory-deliverable-validator to validate this completed advisory deliverable against its contract and evidence, tracing every material reasoning dependency.
advisory-deliverable-validator.instructions: Provide the completed memo, report, analysis, or presentation, its advisory_contract.json when available, and the selected evidence. Clara traces every material fact, hypothesis, assumption, calculation, inference, recommendation, and decision condition through its evidence and dependencies, then reviews contract fit, reasoning, contradictions, judgement boundaries, corrections, uncertainty, and delivery readiness. An unresolved critical weakness blocks delivery; existing Clara presentation, HTML-deck, reporting, and deck-correction checks remain authoritative.

attribute-reporting.display_name: Compare assortment, new-product, and best-seller attributes
attribute-reporting.short_description: Compare product attributes across retailer cohorts
attribute-reporting.default_prompt: Use $attribute-reporting to compare the product attributes in this retailer dataset and show the differences between the selected cohorts.
attribute-reporting.instructions: Attach the retailer product dataset and any reviewed attribute mapping, then name the cohorts to compare. Clara maps products to the agreed category taxonomy and returns the attribute findings, exceptions, and a reviewable report.

brand-fit.display_name: Compare the retailer assortment with the brand catalogue
brand-fit.short_description: Find retailer opportunities for a brand catalogue
brand-fit.default_prompt: Use $brand-fit to compare this brand catalogue with the retailer evidence and identify the strongest assortment opportunities.
brand-fit.instructions: Provide the retailer analysis, evidence of the brand's current presence, and the brand-owned catalogue. Clara distinguishes current assortment gaps from new catalogue opportunities and returns an evidence-linked Brand Fit assessment.

claim-basis-map.short_description: Link presentation claims to their evidence
claim-basis-map.default_prompt: Use $claim-basis-map to check the claims in this presentation against its source materials and flag anything unsupported or out of date.
claim-basis-map.instructions: Attach the presentation and its source materials. Clara links each slide claim to a source, calculation, reasoning step, or unsupported status and returns a readable claims map with any text that needs correction.

deck-correction.short_description: Turn feedback into verified presentation changes
deck-correction.default_prompt: Use $deck-correction to apply this feedback to the presentation while preserving content that was not challenged.
deck-correction.instructions: Attach the current presentation and the transcript, notes, recording, or comments containing the requested changes. Clara turns the feedback into an evidence-linked change ledger, protects untouched content, and returns a revised presentation with verification findings when editing tools are available.

html-deck.default_prompt: Use $html-deck to turn these source materials into a clear HTML presentation for this audience and decision.
html-deck.instructions: Provide the source documents or data, intended audience, and decision the presentation must support. Clara develops a source-bound storyline, keeps claims and numbers traceable, and returns a reviewable standalone HTML presentation when file tools are available.

interview.short_description: Prepare and review a structured interview
interview.default_prompt: Use $interview to prepare an interview for this research objective and participant, then organize the resulting evidence.
interview.instructions: Describe the research objective, participant role, language, and approved brief. Clara prepares the interview; when hosted interview tools are available, she creates the participant link and returns the completed transcript and evidence bundle with a quality review.

privacy-surface-review.short_description: Review how a Clara workflow handles data
privacy-surface-review.default_prompt: Use $privacy-surface-review to review the data boundaries, retention, accounts, and controls of this Clara workflow change.
privacy-surface-review.instructions: Identify the Clara workflow or hosted service being added or changed and provide the relevant source files. Clara inventories model-readable data, external boundaries, accounts, retention, and controls, then returns the updated privacy record and validation findings.

reporting-engine.short_description: Turn business data into checked reporting
reporting-engine.default_prompt: Use $reporting-engine to analyze this Excel file and prepare a clear chart and reporting plan for the business question it should answer.
reporting-engine.instructions: Attach the Excel file and state the business question or decision it should support. Clara checks the fields, calculations, metrics, dimensions, and chart choices, then returns a source-backed reporting plan with ambiguities clearly marked.

research-video.short_description: Turn approved research scenes into a narrated video
research-video.default_prompt: Use $research-video to turn these approved research scenes into a source-grounded 16:9 video with narration in English, Italian, French, German, or Spanish and captions.
research-video.instructions: Provide the research sources and approved scene images, then state the audience, intended duration, and narration language. Clara prepares a source-bound narration and visual plan for review and binds explicit user confirmation to the exact inputs and localized AI-voice disclosure. The authenticated Mparanza Research Video page sends only the approved narration and binding metadata to OpenAI using a server-held credential, returns one audio artifact per scene, and Clara renders a validated MP4 locally without a user API key. Images and sources remain local. Accepted Vera outputs may be handed off to Clara, but Vera retains the professional source, claim, and publication review.

transcribe.short_description: Turn a recording into reviewed evidence
transcribe.default_prompt: Use $transcribe to transcribe this recording, identify the speakers where possible, and prepare a reviewed evidence package.
transcribe.instructions: Provide the recording, identify the target case or folder, and name any known speakers. Clara produces the transcript, supports speaker attribution, and returns a reviewed evidence package with uncertain passages kept separate from advice.
